note: Based on the genus-level monograph description of Roonwal & Chhotani (1989) (in English), itself recast from the original description of Roonwal & Sen-Sarma 1960; the soldier and the pseudoworker are described and measured, while the alate is given in the original as Imago Unknown. Type specimens examined; type locality Gannoruwa (Peradeniya), Sri Lanka.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule deep yellow to straw; antenna brownish at the base, paler apically; mandibles reddish brown, the teeth nearly black; pronotum, legs and body yellow to pale brown. Pubescence fairly dense. Body length about 7.40—8.50 mm. Head capsule fairly long, subrectangular (head length to mandible base 2.52—2.82, width 1.86—2.04 mm); frons sloping anteriorly, with a shallow depression extending back to the middle of the head; Y-suture distinct. Eyes suboval, whitish, maximum diameter 0.18 mm; minimum eye-antennal distance approximately equal to or slightly greater than the long diameter of the eye (0.18 mm). Ocelli absent. Antenna 13—14 segments, segment 3 longer than 2, segment 4 subequal to or shorter than 2. Postclypeus deeper in colour than the frons, subrectangular, anterior margin with 2 pairs of setae; anteclypeus whitish, fairly prominent. Labrum short, length less than width (length 0.24—0.30, width 0.42—0.48 mm), anterior margin rounded. Mandibles stout and long, about two-thirds of the head length (length 1.62—1.68 mm, mandible length/head length index 0.58—0.64); left mandible with 6 marginal teeth, right with 2. Postmentum slender and long (length 1.74—2.04 mm), club-shaped, widest anteriorly (maximum width 0.60—0.72 mm), narrowing posteriorly into a long waist (waist width 0.18—0.24 mm); the anterior club-shaped region is faintly divided into a larger anterior part and a slightly smaller posterior part, the anterior half with a few setae. Pronotum subrectangular (width 1.56—1.92, length 0.90—1.02 mm), fairly densely setose; width slightly less than or almost equal to the head width (pronotum width/head width index 0.84—0.97); anterior margin convex, medially concave. Legs long and slender, sparsely setose; tibial spur formula 3:3:3, tarsi 4-segmented. Abdomen slender, each tergite with 2 rows of setae; cerci 2-segmented.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Pseudoworker: head capsule, labrum and mandibles straw; mandibular teeth brownish; antenna, pronotum, body and legs pale yellow; head and body densely setose. Body length 5.0—6.5 mm. Head capsule round, head length to mandible base 1.2—1.4, head width 1.25—1.69 mm; Y-suture indistinct. Eyes small white spots. Ocelli absent. Antenna 13—14 segments. Pronotum subrectangular, narrower than the head including the eyes (length 0.4—0.70, width 0.90—1.35 mm).
